caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure with reddish-brown skin, dressed in a brown tunic with yellow trim, a necklace, and a headband adorned with three large feathers—one green and two brown. The figure’s black hair is shoulder-length and the facial features are detailed with a focused expression, looking slightly upwards and to the left. In his left hand, he holds a bundle of cylindrical objects in red, white, and blue bands, possibly cigars. His right hand is bent at the elbow and holds a small cylindrical item vertically against his chest. The figure stands on a brown plinth with slanted sides, on which “PONY AVAITOR” is inscribed in yellow letters on two visible sides. The drawing is centered on an off-white background with no additional objects or background detail. The statue features highlights and shadows, providing dimension and a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Cigar Store Indian
